name: What is hospital negligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hospital negligence occurs when a hospital, its staff, or a healthcare provider within the hospital fails to meet the accepted standard of care, resulting in harm or injury to a patient. This can include errors in diagnosis, treatment, medication, surgery, or facility management. For instance, a hospital might be negligent if a patient contracts an infection due to unsanitary conditions, if there are significant delays in treatment leading to worsened conditions, or if staff fail to properly monitor a patient's vital signs. It is distinct from individual physician malpractice, as it focuses on systemic failures or actions of non-physician staff.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hospital negligence is when a hospital or its staff fail to provide the accepted standard of care, causing patient harm.
